title: Embedding quantization calibration & cosine-drift validation
creator: Asha Menon
description:
Background: We need a repeatable calibration and validation workflow for embedding models that allows safe deployment of INT8/FP16 quantized variants without degrading downstream retrieval/semantic similarity metrics. This ticket defines the calibration protocol, acceptance criteria, and automated cosine-drift checks to run in CI and in the Console during rollout.

Scope: INT8 (symmetric per-channel & per-tensor options) and FP16 production candidates for our embedding family (base-embed-040, dense-512). Excludes extreme quant formats (e.g., FP8) which will be tracked in a follow-up experiment.

Objective: Create a pipeline that 1) produces quantized checkpoints with deterministic calibration statistics, 2) runs evaluation against canonical prompt/embedding sets, 3) computes cosine-similarity drift and retrieval/regression signals, and 4) outputs an actionable pass/fail decision with recommended rollback/thresholds for automated rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Quant calibration jobs (INT8/FP16) produce a metrics.json containing: mean_cosine, median_cosine, 1st_percentile, 5th_percentile, recall@1, recall@10, and percentile_delta between fp32 and quantized embeddings.
CI job that fails the candidate if 95th-percentile cosine delta > 0.015 or recall@10 drop > 1.5% absolute compared to fp32 baseline.
A reproducible calibration dataset and process documented and checked into runtime-quant/quant-calibration-config with seed control and sampling rules.
Dashboard panel in Console showing time-series of mean_cosine and recall@k for each model variant and rollouts tagged with release IDs.
Automation hook that marks a rollout as "unsafe" when cosine drift criteria are exceeded and triggers automatic fallback to last-safe variant.
steps: Assemble calibration corpus: 50k representative queries from production traces (anonymized) + 10k synthetic coverage examples; store as s3://redwood-quant/calibration/2026-02-v1
Calibration run config: run 3 seeds, per-channel symmetric quant, percentile clipping at 99.9th for activations, per-tensor scale for embeddings layer optional flag
Produce quantized checkpoints using quantize.py --mode=int8 --calibration-config=... and log calibration histograms to artifacts bucket
Evaluation harness: generate embeddings for canonical eval set (N=20k) with fp32 and quant variants, compute cosine matrix in batches and derive metrics (mean, median, p1, p5, recall@k)
Store metrics to metrics.json and push to internal dashboard via /api/metrics/ingest; attach artifact links to the Linear ticket
CI gating: add workflow quant-validate.yml which runs on PRs that touch model-config or quant code; failing thresholds defined in acceptance_criteria
Rollout integration: add check in rollout controller to call /api/quant/check?release_id=XXX before promoting canary to 50%
Documentation: write calibration cookbook and troubleshooting notes at confluence.redwood.ai/display/INFR/Embedding+Quant+Calibration
experiments: 2026-02-18: INT8 per-channel symmetric on dense-512 (seed 42) => mean_cosine_delta=0.0068, p5_delta=0.021, recall@10 drop=0.9%; passed internal soft thresholds
2026-02-24: INT8 per-tensor (symmetric) on base-embed-040 => mean_cosine_delta=0.0134, p1_delta=0.045, recall@1 drop=2.2%; flagged for re-calibration (activation clipping adjusted)
2026-03-03: FP16 cast-only baseline on base-embed-040 => mean_cosine_delta=0.0006, no meaningful recall loss; FP16 considered safe for immediate rollout
2026-03-07: INT8 with 99.9 percentile activation clipping + per-channel scales on base-embed-040 => mean_cosine_delta=0.004, recall@10 drop=0.6%; selected as candidate for canary
decisions: Adopt INT8 symmetric per-channel for weights + per-tensor activation scales as the default profile for embedding layers (better stability in experiments).
Use 99.9th percentile clipping for activation calibration by default; allow tuning to 99.5/99.99 for stress runs.
Default similarity metric for drift detection will be cosine similarity with L2 normalization; additional checks will include pairwise dot variance and nearest-neighbor retrieval recall@k.
Automated rollback threshold set to: 95th-percentile cosine delta > 0.015 OR recall@10 drop > 1.5% absolute compared to current production baseline.
blockers: Legal/compliance review required for using sampled production traces in calibration dataset (security is triaging) - block until 2026-03-15 or until synthetic fallback is approved.
CI flakiness: current quant-validate matrix job times out occasionally when computing full pairwise cosine matrix at N>20k; need optimized batched reducer or approximate nearest neighbor baseline.
Need a stable artifact upload endpoint for metrics ingestion (SRE ticket SRE-2911 pending).
comments: 2026-02-11 - Asha Menon: Filed initial ticket after spike. Added baseline fp32 measurements and candidate config files. Next: pick calibration corpus and run first INT8 job.
2026-02-19 - Michael Chen: Ran first per-channel INT8 experiments. Early numbers look promising; pushing artifacts to S3 and creating PR for evaluation harness.
2026-02-25 - Priya Rao (ML): Per-tensor INT8 showed higher P1 drift on tail cases; recommended percentile clipping and redoing calibration with heavier tail coverage.
2026-03-04 - Michael Chen: FP16 appears safe across all evals. Opening canary rollout ticket for FP16. Will reserve INT8 for a subsequent, gated rollout once blockers are cleared.
2026-03-12 - QA: Noted CI timeout on N=25k cosine calculation. Temporary mitigation: sample 20k or use ANN recall@k proxy in CI until reducer optimized.
Action items: (1) Get legal sign-off or use synthetic-only calibration; (2) Optimize pairwise cosine reducer or switch CI to ANN proxy; (3) Add metrics ingestion retry logic.
